title: The Judgment on the False Prophets Ahab and Zedekiah
description: In his letter to the exiles, Jeremiah warns that the false prophets Ahab and Zedekiah, who prophesy lies in the Lord's name, will be handed over to King Nebuchadnezzar and killed before the eyes of the people. The king of Babylon will roast them in fire so that their names become a curse among the exiles. This is because they have committed adultery with their neighbors' wives and spoken lying words which the Lord did not command.
